title: nf-core/bacmodel pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: Assembly FASTA file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fasta', '.fa', '.fna', or '.fasta.gz'

medium_gapseq.errorMessage: Medium for gapseq cannot contain spaces. Can be a medium name (e.g., 'LB', 'M9') or path to CSV file

medium_carveme.errorMessage: Medium name for CarveMe cannot contain spaces. Must correspond to a medium in the mediadb (e.g., 'LB', 'M9')
